title: Tech Note: From Area List Pro to 4D View

historical_commentary.text: Both Area List Pro and 4D View are long-discontinued products with no direct modern equivalents, so this note's specific migration mappings are obsolete; the broader lesson — planning and executing a plug-in-to-plug-in migration by mapping common usage patterns — remains a useful, generally applicable approach whenever developers must migrate off a deprecated dependency.
related_updates: Both Area List Pro and 4D View are discontinued products; modern 4D applications would use list box form objects or web-based grids instead
